text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — onboarding guide splash image is 403 in staging when I open /guides/getting-started. Noticed this from a user flow test just now.
dev-docbot: link-checker failed: 1 broken asset for /guides/getting-started (staging). See run id 2026-03-20-15:42.
Maria Chen: curl output:
```
$ curl -I https://staging-cdn.redwood-inference.internal/onboard-splash.png
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
``` 
Samir Patel: I can take a look. Likely an S3 ACL rotation or short-lived token issue from the deploy yesterday.
Jules Ortega: @Samir can you confirm if the image is stored in the docs bucket or a static assets bucket? I remember we moved some images to the media service last month.
Samir Patel: Looks like media service. Reuploading to the media bucket with public-read now, will push a cache-bust.
Priya Kapoor: If you prefer quick patch, I made a tiny frontmatter-based fallback in staging that points to an internal placeholder image. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — small and safe, but would rather rehost the original.
Samir Patel: grabbing PR for review, will also rehost original and then remove fallback. @Infra SRE can you watch for any bucket policy jobs? I think a cron ran earlier and could have flipped ACLs.
Infra SRE: Confirmed — there was an automated lifecycle job that inadvertently set private on objects tagged tmp-deploy. We rolled it back and are reapplying correct tags. Samir, we will keep the bucket write open for 10m for your fix.
Samir Patel: Uploaded original to media bucket with corrected ACL, cache-busted file name, and updated CDN invalidation request submitted.
Priya Kapoor: Merged #4321 to staging to ensure no break while CDN propagates.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. Can someone re-run the staging link-check job? dev-docbot, can you queue a recheck?
dev-docbot: Scheduling link-checker re-run for /guides/getting-started in 2 minutes. Will post results here.
Jules Ortega: Nice — once recheck is green would you please add the image ownership to the guide frontmatter (owner: @docs-team) so future rot is easier to triage?
Samir Patel: Will add a tiny owner metadata patch in a follow-up commit.
Maria Chen: Awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:
dev-docbot: link-checker run complete: 0 failures for /guides/getting-started (staging).
